### {{< var pi.name >}} {#gyula-kovacs}

::: {.person-role}
{{< var pi.role >}}, {{< var org.short >}}
:::

::: {.person-social}
<a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=de&user=xTXqqyIAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/google-scholar.svg" alt="Google Scholar"></a>
:::

::: {.person-email}
<a href="mailto:gyula.kovacs@uni-jena.de"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/email.svg" alt="Email"><span>gyula.kovacs<wbr>@uni-jena.de</span></a>
:::
:::

::: {.person-body}

Leads the department's research on the neural background of perceptual and cognitive functions, including object and person recognition, the interaction between perception and memory, and predictive neural processes. The work combines electrophysiology, functional imaging, and transcranial magnetic stimulation.

::: {.person-links}
[Learn more]({{< var contact.department_url >}}){.pl-web}
:::

:::

:::

## Doctoral candidates

::: {.person}

::: {.person-aside}
<img class="person-photo" src="/assets/people/andras-sarkozy.jpeg" alt="Portrait of András Sárközy">

### András Sárközy, MSc {#andras-sarkozy}

::: {.person-role}
Ph.D. candidate, {{< var org.short >}}
:::

::: {.person-email}
<a href="mailto:andras.zoltan.sarkoezy@uni-jena.de"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/email.svg" alt="Email"><span>andras.zoltan.sarkoezy<wbr>@uni-jena.de</span></a>
:::
:::

::: {.person-body}

Research focuses on consciousness and conscious access: how and when sensory information becomes available to subjective experience and report, and how prior expectations shape it. This work draws on psychophysics, eye tracking, pupillometry, and fMRI. A second line of research concerns neurodegeneration, first approached through molecular genetics and now studied in older and clinical populations, combining pupillometry with 7T fMRI during attention and cognitive control tasks. Altered states of consciousness, including psychedelic states, are a further interest that grows out of these questions.

:::

:::

::: {.person}

::: {.person-aside}
<img class="person-photo" src="/assets/people/yang-shi.jpeg" alt="Portrait of Yang Shi">

### Yang Shi, MSc {#yang-shi}

::: {.person-role}
Ph.D. candidate, {{< var org.short >}}
:::

::: {.person-social}
<a href="https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Yang-Shi-51"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/researchgate.svg" alt="ResearchGate"></a>
:::

::: {.person-email}
<a href="mailto:yang.shi@uni-jena.de"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/email.svg" alt="Email"><span>yang.shi<wbr>@uni-jena.de</span></a>
:::
:::

::: {.person-body}

Research interests focus on the multidimensional factors that shape identity processing and familiarization during social interactions. This research combines EEG and fMRI with machine-learning-based multivariate analysis to investigate the neural representations and dynamics underlying person perception and familiarity.

:::

:::

::: {.person}

::: {.person-aside}
<img class="person-photo" src="/assets/people/yeliz-dinc.jpeg" alt="Portrait of Yeliz Dinc">

### Yeliz Dinc, MSc {#yeliz-dinc}

::: {.person-role}
Ph.D. candidate, {{< var org.short >}}
:::

::: {.person-social}
<a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Rcr0Dw4AAAAJ&hl=tr"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/google-scholar.svg" alt="Google Scholar"></a>
:::

::: {.person-email}
<a href="mailto:yeliz.dinc@uni-jena.de"><img class="social-icon" src="/assets/icons/email.svg" alt="Email"><span>yeliz.dinc<wbr>@uni-jena.de</span></a>
:::
:::

::: {.person-body}

Research focuses on face perception and recognition, particularly familiarity, memory, and individual differences in face-recognition ability, and on how semantic information and visual context shape the way identities are processed and recognized. Using EEG and multivariate pattern analysis, this work investigates the neural processes involved in face recognition. Also involved in teaching the EmPra course "Face Recognition in Cognitive Neuroscience." Outside the lab, Yeliz enjoys spending time with her cat, being in nature, good food, and sports.

:::
